map.井字棋（人机/双人） 使用指南: Tic-Tac-Toe (vs Computer / Two Players) User Guide
map.3×3 棋盘轮流落子，先连成一线（横/竖/斜）者胜；满盘无连线判平局。人机模式常: Players take turns on a 3×3 board and the first to complete a line (row, column or diagonal) wins; a full board with no line is a draw. Computer mode usually uses Minimax search for the optimal move.
map.休闲对弈打发时间: Casual play to pass the time
map.演示极小化极大（Minimax）博弈算法: Demonstrates the minimax game search algorithm
map.亲子/教学讲解轮流决策: Parent-and-child or teaching explanation of turn-based decisions
map.先手有必胜策略吗？: Does the first player have a winning strategy?
map.双方都最优时必平局；先手占中心可最大化不败概率，但无法保证必胜。: With both sides optimal it is always a draw. Taking the centre maximises the chance of not losing but cannot guarantee a win.
map.电脑难度怎么调？: How do I adjust computer difficulty?
map.可切换随机/启发式/Minimax 全搜索；难度越高越难被击败，纯前端即可运行。: You can switch between random, heuristic and full Minimax search; the higher the difficulty the harder it is to beat, and it runs purely in the front end.
